integrity: The saturation constant had been proposed numerically in the primary source; the new claim is the exact full-time blocked-site law and rigorous proof, not discovery of that number. Computational checks are supporting evidence, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Equal A/B rates; nearest-neighbour incompatibility; infinite one-dimensional lattice; repeated independent Poisson attempts. No exact finite-cycle formula or extension to unequal rates or higher dimensions. Novelty remains subject to independent historical priority assessment.
title: Exact transient blocking and rigorous saturation in two-colour one-dimensional adsorption
